title: Vanishing Initialization Turns Diagonal Tensor Gradient Flow into Greedy Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.29484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study gradient-flow (GF) learning of tensors from vanishing initialization in canonical polyadic (CP) factorization models. For tensors of order $\nu\geq3$ whose targets are diagonal in mode-wise orthonormal bases, we prove that the limiting learning dynamics follows a simple greedy bipartite matching process. Each rank-one component of the model, called an atom, can potentially learn each rank-one component of the target, called a scalar sector. Every atom--sector pair has an initialization-dependent activation clock, representing the time at which the atom would grow to macroscopic size in that sector if the pair evolved in isolation. Processing these clocks in increasing order and selecting a pair whenever neither its atom nor its sector has been selected before determines the sequence of actual learning events. translated_title: 消失的初始化将对角张量梯度流转化为贪心匹配
translated_abstract: 我们研究在典范多线性（CP）分解模型中，从消失初始化出发的张量梯度流（GF）学习问题。对于阶数 ν≥3 且目标张量在逐模态正交归一基下为对角的情形，我们证明其极限学习动力学遵循一个简单的贪心二部匹配过程。模型的每个秩一分量（称为“原子”）都有可能学习目标的每个秩一分量（称为“标量扇区”）。每个原子—扇区对都有一个依赖于初始化的激活时钟，表示若该对独立演化时原子在该扇区中增长到宏观尺寸所需的时间。按时间递增的顺序处理这些时钟，并在某对的原子与扇区均未被先前选中时选择该对，这一过程决定了实际学习事件的发生顺序。我们证明梯度流轨迹收敛到相应的已学习目标分量所构成的阶梯结构。
tldr: 该论文证明，在CP分解模型中从消失初始化出发的对角张量梯度流学习，其极限动力学可精确刻画为一个由初始化依赖激活时钟驱动的贪心二部匹配过程，梯度流轨迹收敛到相应的阶梯状学习结果。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that gradient-flow learning of diagonal tensors from vanishing initialization in CP factorization models follows a greedy bipartite matching process driven by initialization-dependent activation clocks, with the trajectory converging to a corresponding staircase of learned components.
